relations.text: Otter Tailが10-Kで、製造部門の顧客の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Otter Tail names Toro among customers of its manufacturing businesses

source.label: Otter Tail 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our customers include some of the largest vehicle and equipment manufacturers operating in the U.S., including Caterpillar Inc., CNH Industrial N.V., Cummins Inc., Deere & Company, Honda Motor Co., Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Polaris Inc. and The Toro Company.

companies.sub: 住宅用品・ガレージドア

relations.text: 豪州の散水用品事業PopeをGriffon傘下AMESに売却(2024年)
relations.text_en: Sold its Australian watering business Pope to Griffon's AMES (2024)

source.label: Griffon 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: acquiring substantially all the assets of Pope, a leading Australian provider of residential watering products, from The Toro Company (NYSE:TTC) for a purchase price of approximately AUD 21,800 (approximately $14,500) in cash.

relations.text: Deereが10-Kで、農業・芝刈り機の競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Deere names Toro a competitor in agriculture and turf

source.label: Deere 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: The competitive environment for the agriculture and turf operations includes some global competitors, such as AGCO Corporation, CLAAS KGaA mbH, CNH Industrial N.V., Kubota Tractor Corporation, Mahindra & Mahindra Limited, and The Toro Company.

companies.name: ダグラス・ダイナミクス

relations.text: Douglas Dynamicsが10-Kで、除雪機器の最大の競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Douglas Dynamics names Toro (Boss brand) its next-largest snowplow competitor

source.label: Douglas Dynamics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the next largest competitors in the market for snow and ice control equipment for light trucks are The Toro Company (the manufacturer of the Boss brand of snow and ice control equipment)

relations.text: Generacが10-Kで、家庭用製品の競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Generac names Toro among residential product competitors

source.label: Generac 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Husqvarna, Ariens, Tesla, Enphase, Solar Edge, Google, Resideo, The Toro Company, EcoFlow, and Emerson
